notes: app 1.11.7 -> 1.11.8, chart 0.10.0 and vLLM image v0.29.0 unchanged. App: the AI versions the attached file instead of creating a copy, a tunable execution budget and a safe slide insert for small models in the sandbox, and the agents now say when a targetFileId matches no file. Deploy: the host layer travels with the update as one signed bundle (host_layer_sha256) laid down by update.sh and converged in place, so a box updated from an older install gets the model page, the backup page and remote access without a reinstall; its vLLM unit gains the CDI refresh, Gemma stays on its pinned cu130-nightly while the base image is v0.29.0, and the embed gets its 4 GiB KV cap. A box on the previous updater installs the new one at the end of this apply and is then offered the host layer on its next check.
